nodes.blurb: The Jain dharma: non-violence (ahimsa), non-possessiveness and many-sidedness (anekantavada) on the tirthankara path.
nodes.label: Jainism

nodes.blurb: The Chinese Way: Daodejing and Zhuangzi, inner alchemy, ritual and martial lineages (Quanzhen, Zhengyi, Wudang).
nodes.label: Taoism

nodes.blurb: The Baha'i Faith: unity of God, religion and humanity; no clergy, elected assemblies; Houses of Worship open to all.
nodes.label: Baha'i Faith

nodes.blurb: African diaspora religions of the Americas, entered only via heritage-listed houses with published contacts.
nodes.label: African diaspora religions

nodes.blurb: Ketu-nation Candomblé of Bahia: orixá worship, entered via the IPHAN-listed Ilê Axé Opô Afonjá (1910).
nodes.label: Candomblé

nodes.blurb: The peyote way of the North American tribes; pan-tribal church body (NACNA). Tribally rooted, not drop-in.
nodes.label: Native American Church
